purpose_context: Four defects share one shape: a surface that looks authoritative but silently misdirects. The P0 (#2985) makes spec-kitty accept append a historical claim event after a work package's terminal transition, so a finished WP reads as claimed, accept stops converging, and the mission cannot proceed to lane consolidation. The other three misdirect agents rather than data: profile-load surfaces instruct raw agent.yaml reads that bypass doctrine resolution (#1840), a plain-language styleguide teaches a command that does not exist (#2983), and the invocation lifecycle opens under one command path and closes under another (#2984). Together they cost users corrupted mission state and cost agents wasted passes following guidance that cannot work.
purpose_tldr: Fix a P0 that rewinds finished work packages to claimed, and three agent-facing papercuts where shipped guidance points at the wrong command or bypasses doctrine resolution.
